leadText:
Fleurrh City (Japanese: フレイシティ Frey City) is an -exclusive location in Kalos, located between Couriway Town and Snowbelle City. Like many other in the region, it is home to a Pokémon Showcase theater. It is the hometown of .

It was first mentioned by Monsieur Pierre in Party Dancecapades!, when he told the attendees at his dance party that the city would host an upcoming Pokémon Showcase Rookie Class. The competition took place in Master Class Choices! where , Amelia, and many other Pokémon Performers entered the event hoping to win the Fleurrh City .

During the Theme Performance, in which contestants had to place the highest number of on their part of the field before time ran out, Serena was grouped with Kazalie and Concetta. She put her racing skills to good use and gathered a large group of Rhyhorn, defeating her opponents. Amelia and Shulin also managed to advance to the second round. However, Alouette, Clarice, and Sara Lee ended up being eliminated.

In the Freestyle Performance, Amelia dazzled the crowd together with her and . Serena also impressed the audience with her , , and . In the end, their score could not be closer, but as Serena had received just a few more points, she was declared the winner, thus earning her third and final Princess Key and qualifying for the Master Class.
